scope: Maps dependency. Request completion and cancellation in the Android location adapter on the OpenHarmony board.

boardArtTest.method: Two headless ART processes loaded their respective staged adapter and native bridge. An identical process-local test provider supplied synthetic callbacks before start returned, during the first answer, and after cancellation. Hardware and app permissions were not involved.
boardArtTest.entryPoints: The one-shot test drives the adapter request registry, native start, and handle handoff directly. Listener replacement and removal run through ILocationManager.

nativeAllocationTest.method: Count allocations in the actual bridge source using an in-process LocationKit test provider. Each successful request started and stopped, then the provider issued a late callback. One additional start was rejected.

physicalProvider.sourceObservation: In this checkout, a disconnected NetworkAbility::RequestRecord returns before requesting a network location if the configured provider bundle is missing. ConnectNlpService also requires its ability name. The board vendor implementation was not rebuilt from this checkout.

acceptance: One-shot delivery, cancellation and native allocation cleanup passed in the controlled tests. A physical fix in the original Maps APK and overall two-path app acceptance remain open.
